meta.title: GitHub
meta.description: Adds a GitHub workspace to the left rail: sign in with a personal access token and stay signed in, browse the public repositories created in the last 7 days with the most stars, search repositories, and inspect a repository inside the panel (Code/Issues tabs, branch switching, clone menu, file and README views, Star). The token is kept only in this machine’s DSH credential store. Open it from the GitHub icon in the left rail or “Open the GitHub workspace” on this bundle’s page; turning the plugin off removes the panel and its sign-in.
